goal: Deliver the bounded planned extent: External bootstrap custody and consumer inventory

starting_authority.release_authority: NOT GRANTED — normal Wave 2 release admission required before IMPLEMENT

allowed_scope.extent: Produce a current bootstrap custody manifest covering all discovered external assets, exact revisions/hashes, consumers/service references, test/evidence provenance, and a truthful per-component custody class. Include newly discovered shell helpers/Factory Director Host. Unknowns are explicit and local to the affected component. Perform no migration, deletion, service change, live replacement, cutover or retirement.
allowed_scope.boundary: Only this node extent. Requirement/design references constrain execution and do not absorb sibling scopes.
non_goals: Replanning the DAG or implementing another node; changing requirements, closing authority gaps or selecting withdrawn architecture policy.
Automatic release, live operation or retirement from a candidate or local proof result.
architecture_constraints: Apply the pinned shared contracts and linked contract sections within this node extent. No service or context boundary beyond the pinned design, RAI wiring or adopted withdrawn edge table.
Preserve compatible interfaces, persisted resource identities, one-writer ownership and existing approved architecture checks.
Do not assume the historical eighteen-module list is complete. Discover current assets and consumers read-only; preserve KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED protections.

dependencies.completion_predicate: Real temporary SQLite; disposable local bare Git remote, publication/fetch into a fresh verifier worktree, local work-management and provider transport, injected clock/IDs, durable scripted worker journal, credentials absent and enforced denied outbound network with attempted-network refusal. Count zero provider calls. Run existing kernel unchanged and report success-collapse limitation; no scripted lifecycle transitions.

required_evidence: Retain exact fixture/source/profile/candidate revisions, invocation and command, expected/observed result, exit status, immutable observation refs, independent verdict where required; never infer operational success from a local result.

Retain predecessor candidate identities, proof fixture revision, full command/exit status, raw observations, negative-control application counts and independent verdicts separately. Preserve prior proof on repair; supersession needs explicit authority.
Retain all authority dispositions and migration/rollback/readback receipts applicable to this node. Missing or unavailable measurements are explicit holds, never zero or PASS.

criteria: Produce a current bootstrap custody manifest covering all discovered external assets, exact revisions/hashes, consumers/service references, test/evidence provenance, and a truthful per-component custody class. Include newly discovered shell helpers/Factory Director Host. Unknowns are explicit and local to the affected component. Perform no migration, deletion, service change, live replacement, cutover or retirement.
material_failure_classes: Inventory discovers the current external bootstrap surface rather than assuming the historical eighteen-module list is complete.
Each discovered asset retains exact path plus content/revision identity and attributable consumers/service references where observable.
Custody classification distinguishes live KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED protections, historical/provenance utilities, replacement-proof candidates and explicit UNKNOWN without inventing retirement authority.
Unknowns block only the affected component classification/replacement path; unrelated inventory remains reportable.
The inventory pass performs zero migration, deletion, service restart/stop, cutover or retirement effects.
non_claims: No external bootstrap file is deleted, moved or rewritten.
No service is started/stopped/restarted and no replacement/retirement is authorized.

candidate_custody.policy: Future PRODUCER pins contract/input/baseline/profile and candidate branch+full SHA; publishes candidate to configured authorized remote and records exact branch/SHA on the Issue before RESULT=VERIFY. Fresh independent verifier retrieves that exact SHA in its own worktree; retain retrieval and verdict receipts.
candidate_custody.closure: Retain actor-owned branch/worktree through required closure; disposition LANDED, DISCARDED or PARKED with durable blocker. No direct main push by a BIU worker.
candidate_custody.current_artifact: Candidate specification only; no Issue, branch publication, implementation commit or worker invocation created by Phase 12.

landing: SWF-19: normal merge exact accepted candidate SHA; no pull request.
stop_condition: Hold this BIU on unmet dependency proof, unbound budget/custody, authority gap/gate, source revision mismatch, unavailable evidence, failing discriminating probe or conflicting ownership. Preserve unrelated completed proof.
escalation_condition: Inventory/classification uncertainty is recorded as UNKNOWN for the affected component and does not block unrelated inventory.
Any migration, deletion, service change, live replacement, cutover or retirement requires its separately authorized proof/decision and is outside B0.
readiness: fresh native Agent Ready assessment of this exact work-unit revision required before READY; no release authority
